groundedSamples.title: Retrocon 2027 ganhou dados!
sourceFactInventory: Veja quando acontece a aguardada feira retrogamer Retrocon 2027
A maior e melhor feira de retrogames do Brasil já tem data marcada para voltar, então anote aí na sua agenda!
Em live realizada ontem (22) entre os sócios-fundadores Gilão , da Mr. Games, Cleber Marques , da Warpzone, e Tiozão , da Casa do Videogame, foi revelada a data exata da Retrocon 2027.
A Retrocon 2027 vai rolar nos dias 23, 24 e 25 de julho de 2027 , novamente no Transamerica Expo Center em São Paulo, SP.
Ainda não foram revelados detalhes sobre preços e atrações, apenas um lembrete para que todos os entusiastas de retrogames tenham a data em mente para as suas agendas no ano que vem.
Em 2026 a principal atração foi a vinda do lendário artista Kevin Bayliss , criador dos Battletoads, Diddy Kong e outras grandes marcas e jogos da Rare em seu auge nos anos 1990.

groundedSamples.title: O primeiro personagem MMO de um jornalista: Leetman, o humano ladrão
groundedSamples.completeFinalBody:
My first character was...

Leetman, Human Rogue Born: ~2004-2006 Game: World of Warcraft My first ever character was in World of Warcraft, after—as my bio states—I pretty much begged my parents to give me a WoW subscription, and was rewarded for my articulation with a proper WoW account and a life-changingly debilitating enthusiasm for videogames.

And while I did technically have a Runescape character before this, I can't remember 'em, so Leetman is here.

I was not a good rogue.

In my defense, I was 10 years old—but I didn't level my poisons, I didn't reach level cap, and the height of my career was spent futzing around Un'Goro Crater.

I did, however, manage to get the gold for a mount, which made me feel pretty swanky.

That was a big deal back in the day.

Leetman would eventually be traded out for the troll shaman Earthborn when The Burning Crusade rolled around, but I shall remember him fondly.

Perhaps his reticence to use poison was merely a question of honour—but he's deleted, now, so we shall never know.

(Read the full article here)

groundedSamples.title: Wardogs Season 2 terá data de lançamento e adição de condições climáticas
sourceFactInventory: Wardogs Season 2 has a release date, and the new content update will add weather effects, including rain.

Wardogs Season 2 will arrive on October 15, and although we don't know much about it yet, we do know that it will add weather to the game. The first teaser showcases heavy rainfall over a battlefield, suggesting players will have to deal with the elements going forward.

Whether this will add any changes to the gameplay, such as making it harder to drive or creating visibility issues, remains to be seen. If handled right, it could really shake up the Wardogs experience, especially if weather comes and goes dynamically rather than being enabled in specific matches.
WARDOGS Season 02 is coming. Stay tuned for more. pic.twitter.com/XTEa3mPGj9

Season 2 will also feature a progress wipe, resetting everyone's unlocks and ranks back to square one. The aim is to rebalance the scales at the start of each season of Wardogs, preventing players who grind the game endlessly from dominating forever. In theory, without a wipe, it could devalue the entire in-game economy as players will eventually unlock everything and lose the incentive to do anything beyond killing enemies. However, some fans are understandably annoyed that they will have to re-unlock everything just one month after the game's early access launch.

Wardogs has become one of the biggest games of the year, selling over two million copies in its first weekend. It's unclear where the game is at now sales-wise, but it is continuing to be one of the most played games on Steam . We'll have to wait and see what Season 2 brings, but it seems like developer Bulkhead has no plans to slow down on expanding the game with exciting content.

Wardogs is also coming to consoles , but it won't be for a while. The team is targeting a 2028 release for the console version of the game, and a big reason for that is so that the team won't have to crunch . In a recent interview, Bulkhead CEO Joe Brammer noted that although there is pressure to make a console version, he doesn't want to overwork the team.

groundedSamples.title: Franquia Sonic quase foi encerrada, mas filme salvou em 2020
sourceFactInventory: De acordo com o chefe do Sonic Team, a SEGA estava preparada para encerrar a franquia de vez

A franquia Sonic completou 35 anos em 2026 e certamente teve seus momentos de glória e seus perrengues ao longo do caminho. Contudo, de acordo com Takashi Iizuka, chefe do estúdio por trás do ouriço azul, a série quase foi cancelada para sempre pela SEGA, mas foi salva pelo sucesso do filme live action de 2020.

Em entrevista ao site One More Game durante a Tokyo Game Show 2026, Takeshi Iizuka compartilhou detalhes sobre a história de Sonic e sua jornada de 35 anos – idade, inclusive, que o diretor diz ser maior que a idade de seus filhos.

Entretanto, uma informação curiosa acabou se destacando. De acordo com o diretor da série, a SEGA chegou a cogitar cancelar a franquia inteira, algo que necessitou de muita briga com os executivos de alto escalão – e ajuda do sucesso comercial do primeiro filme, lançado em 2020.

Houve bons momentos e houve momentos ruins... durante os piores momentos, meus superiores me disseram que deveríamos cancelar toda a franquia. Eu tive que lutar dentro da organização para manter a franquia pelo maior tempo possível. O maior marco para mim foi o primeiro filme... ele foi um grande sucesso e definitivamente mudou o rumo dessa série.”

Pois é, o primeiro filme de Sonic pode ter sido responsável por salvar a franquia toda. Aquele filme, aquele que começou com a revelação de um modelo 3D que causou um grande alvoroço entre fãs e os fãs e um retrabalho na obra inteira – e até ganhou repercussão como o “Sonic Feio”, que até apareceu no filme “Tico e Teco: Defensores da Lei” de 2022.

Outra curiosidade da entrevista de Iizuka é que, ao que tudo indica, Shadow deveria ter morrido no final de Sonic Adventures 2, mas a popularidade do personagem se manteve alta e isso acabou salvando sua participação na série.

groundedSamples.title: Minecraft Consegue Derrotar a Si Mesmo Depois de Quase 2 Bilhões de Anos Simulados
sourceFactInventory: Minecraft is no stranger to simulations, but it turns out that under the right conditions, the game can beat itself... if given billions of years.

This was discovered by YouTuber RedLogic , who built a custom Minecraft simulation to see if the game could ever beat itself without a player ever joining. Two billion years is a bit too long to watch this play out in real time, of course, so he used a Monte Carlo simulation to "compress billions of ticks into explicitly sampled waiting times, while explicitly tracking rare events and the physical resources that can advance or destroy the chain."
